# Code of conduct

We follow the [Contributor Covenant 3.0](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/3/0/code_of_conduct/), same as Light. Be kind, be honest, and assume good faith.

If something's wrong, contact [@zachgrosser](https://github.com/zachgrosser) privately (email is on the profile), or use GitHub's "Report content" option. Reports are kept confidential.
